data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 研讨会档案库的无声默契
data.description: 千禧年研讨会极具科幻感的服务器机房内，蓝白色冷光在金属地面与玻璃柜间流淌。诺亚身穿笔挺合身的研讨会白大衣，单手端着泛着微光的平板电脑，倚靠在控制台前。她微微侧过头，紫罗兰眼眸带着看透一切的深邃与温柔，静静守候在加班的老师身边。
data.action: leaning against server console, holding tablet, glowing screen, gentle confident smile
data.lighting: cool blue ambient server rack glow with warm overhead task lights
data.mood: quiet intellectual intimacy and serene focus
data.promptProse: In a quiet futuristic seminar server archive at midnight, Ushio Noa leans gracefully against a console in her tailored white coat, holding a glowing tablet and looking forward with a gentle, knowing smile.
data.animaCaption: She leans against the console holding her tablet; the warm overhead task light illuminates her face against the cool server racks.
